title: PushSubscription
description: A Web Push subscription the operator's PWA persists so the Minion can send a notification on run completion (F-012, FR-E2). Written client-side by the PWA (the first client-writable Firestore collection) at `pushSubscriptions/{sha256(endpoint)}`; read server-side by the Minion. Source of truth for both the PWA writer and the Minion sender.

endpoint.description: Push service endpoint URL from the browser PushSubscription. The sha256 of this value is the Firestore document id, so re-subscribing upserts rather than duplicating.

keys.description: Client public encryption keys from the PushSubscription, used by the sender (pywebpush) to encrypt the payload.

operatorEmail.description: The allowed operator's email. Lets the Firestore ownership rule assert the writer owns this subscription (constitution §2.1 mono-tenant boundary).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the subscription was created/refreshed.
